inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver had twelve children in the classroom. The specified age group was two years old, therefore the caregiver was over child/caregiver ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A one month old was observed sleeping in the crib with a burp rag covering the infant's legs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: A television in one of the toddler rooms was not anchored.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: RECITE: Two caregivers were observed utilizing their cell phones while caring for a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan: One of the eight children's files reviewed documented that the child had diagnosed food allergies, but there was no allergy action plan available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One of the eight children's files reviewed did not have a parent's signature of authorization for emergency medical care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Six of the eight staff files reviewed had BLS certifications and did not include first aid certifications or training certificates.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two staff members left their napping groups unaccompanied during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Six of the eight children's files reviewed were missing information, including admission dates, emergency contact information,  healthcare information, emergency care authorization, special care statements, physician-signed health statements, updated immunization records, verification of receipt of the operational policies, and emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: A caregiver was observed in a classroom, counted in ratio, but did not have at least eight hours of pre-service training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: In several of the rooms, including the pre-k, toddler twos, and toddler rooms, the rooms were observed to be very dark and did not allow for proper supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Two of the eight caregiver files reviewed did not include a notarized employment affidavit available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was observed utilizing their cell phone while caring for a group of sleeping children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Two children were observed in seats that required safety straps not buckled in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was observed utilizing a cell phone watching videos that did not relate to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Three classrooms that had children under 2 years old present were using the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: There were two recalled poppy pillow loungers in the infant room.   NOTE: This was corrected when CCR removed the pillows.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §746.4135(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The two year classroom was left unsupervised during naptime.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was responsible for 21 children. The specified age of the children was 4 years old. One caregiver is allowed to care for 18 children with the specified age of group being 4 years old. The caregiver was over ratio by 3 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The rugs in the infant/toddlers room were dirty.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies lacked #18,20,23,24,26, and 28.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The operations floors, toilets, and sinks were observed dirty.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink (26 TAC §746.2405(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Seven out of nine infant feeding schedules were not updated for the month of October.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One out of ten children files lacked an address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A highchair used by children is stained and the top layer of the highchair tray is peeling off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: The toddler room activty plan was not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed a person to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver restricted food as punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: All operational polices were not available for review.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of nine children files checked did not have current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver had 30 children in her care with the specified age being 3 years old. This caregiver was over ratio by 15 children.

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: One infant 4 months old was observed with a baby activity mat in the pack n play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: Multiple children under the age of 5 were observed in a play area that does not have a fence on all sides .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the 18month-24month room multi purpose spray was on the sink accessible to children. Also in this room there were one electrical outlet that did not have a cover.    Note: Both of these were corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Three out of eight staff files were lacking CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: Two fans were not mounted in the three and four year old classroom and were accessible to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: At the time of inspection there were four nap mats that were ripped and the foam was protruding.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: At the time of inspection a three year old child was in the infant room during nap time.  This was corrected when the child was returned to the three year old class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: At the time of inspection one child in care did not have an admission form on file.  This was corrected when the child was removed from care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: At the time of inspection the caregiver in the infant room did not wash their hands after diaper change.   This was corrected when the caregiver washed their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: At the time of inspection there were 16 two year old children with one caregiver.    This was corrected when a second caregiver joined the group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The base board in the infant room, three and four year old classroom, two year old classroom, and the 12 to 18 month old classroom was coming off the wall.  There was one spot on the wall where the sheet rock was broken in the three and four year old classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: The diaper changing mat was not sanitized after the diaper change.  This was corrected when the diaper changing mat was sanitized.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant feeding schedule was expired at the tie of inspection.    This was corrected when the parent signed and dated the feeding schedule.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There was two screws protruding in the two year old classroom where the cabinet door was removed.    There were two screws protruding from the doorway where the gate was removed, accessible to children.    These were all removed and corrected.    There were three hearing aid batteries on the floor in the front entrance of the center, accessible to the children in care.  This was corrected when they were discarded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: At the time of inspection, the caregiver in the infant room did not wash the child's hands after diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Toys Choking Hazard (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Annual Fire Inspection has not been completed. The last Fire Inspection was conducted on 01/05/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Infants were served snack on the bare table without a napkin or papertowel.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection with the caregiver using paper towels during snack time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))
